$description: Closed set of motion patterns observed on the page. Every PageSpec node declares {pattern, reducedMotionFallback}; the fallback is const-locked to the pattern and describes what the SOURCE actually does under prefers-reduced-motion ('ungated-in-source' = no reduced-motion rule exists; flagged as an accessibility gap, not a recommendation).

noEntranceAnimations.statement: No entrance/scroll-reveal animations exist; the global observer only pauses off-screen loops.

evidence.anchor: toggles the `is-visible` class. CSS then pauses off-screen loops
Static section: no JS behaviour, no animations in the original.

film-grain-overlay.description: Animated SVG feTurbulence seed (0->100 over 10s) behind .noise at opacity .08, plus static scanlines + RGB fringe.
film-grain-overlay.accessibilityGap: The source has no prefers-reduced-motion rule for the grain seed animation.

ticker-marquee.description: Hero news ticker translates -50% at 30px/s (duration = group width / 30), pauses on hover/focus-within and when .hero is off-screen. Includes the ungated 4s watermark glitch.
ticker-marquee.accessibilityGap: hero-watermark glitch (4s) is NOT disabled under reduced motion in the source.

review-funnel-loop.description: 12s CSS loops on the review-funnel illustration (queue-build / rework / risk / finding / flow).
review-funnel-loop.offscreenPauseNote: QA-verified: funnel loops are NOT paused off-screen (no .is-visible rule).

evidence.anchor: the original does NOT pause these loops off-screen

walkthrough-autoplay.description: 4-step walkthrough, 10s per step with 1.8s sub-phases revealing chat messages; play gate = 35% visibility of .product-demo and !document.hidden; user click stops autoplay.
walkthrough-autoplay.hoverNote: QA-verified: the walkthrough button hover tint is defined but NEVER visible (loses on specificity). Do not encode a hover state.

stepper-autoadvance.description: How-it-works stepper: active fill runs 6s linear then advances 1->2->3->1; paused unless >=10% visible and not hovered; card height tween 0.4s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1); body reveal grid-template-rows .4s.
stepper-autoadvance.accessibilityGap: QA-verified: the stepper keeps auto-advancing every 6s under reduced motion; only the schematic route/discovery/data-stream loops stop.

disclosure-grid-rows.description: FAQ <details>: answer grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr over 0.3s ease; chevron rotates 180deg; native close is instant.

cta-flow-glow-glitch.description: 8 flow-dot paths on the wave grid (14/16/18s loops), 3s bloom glow pulse on the mark, 5s/4.5s glitch clip on the heading. Flow dots pause off-screen.
cta-flow-glow-glitch.accessibilityGap: Glow pulse and heading glitch clip are not gated by reduced motion in the source.
